label: Line 8a, column (h): gain
description: Schedule D (2025) line 8a, column (h): totals for transactions not reported on Form 8949, for the bounded covered-long-term-gain class (ADR-0052 Decision 3). Column (h) is column (d) minus column (e); each is itemized separately in the Schedule D attachment's own citation walk.

published_value.explain: A current derived finding publishes column (h) as the tied-out difference of columns (d) and (e).

computed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a computed zero from present proceeds and basis findings that net to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: A current derived finding publishes a zero because the proceeds and basis families are attested closed on their current horizons with no recorded members.

blocked.explain: Line 8a is blocked because the proceeds or basis subtotal is unavailable, or the eligible-transaction family is unclosed.

guard_inapplicable.explain: No line 8a value exists for this route.
